rationale: EO 9762 (11 FR 8073) transferred the Office of Economic Stabilization, the Economic Stabilization Director's functions and the Economic Stabilization Board to the Office of War Mobilization and Reconversion. EO 9809 (11 FR 14281, signed 1946-12-12, effective immediately for paragraphs 1 to 3) consolidated the Office of War Mobilization and Reconversion and the Office of Economic Stabilization into the Office of Temporary Controls, vested the Economic Stabilization Director's functions in the Temporary Controls Administrator, and terminated the Economic Stabilization Board transferred by EO 9762; EO 9841 then terminated the Office of Temporary Controls. The transferred structures no longer exist and no unperformed command remains, so the order had no operative force on 2026-10-14. EO 9809 does not name 9762 for revocation, so formal revocation is not claimed. Recommended status: no.
